title: Warehouse Entry Bag Check weighing and Manual Sorting system
creator: Dhanvanthri Engineers
review_method: Agent visual screening of frames sampled every ten seconds; not a human ground-truth annotation
observed_content: Workers feed sacks into a warehouse conveyor and weighing line
Workers handle bags beside the line

limitations: Inbound handling rather than warehouse returns inspection
Routing may depend on weight or instructions not visible at decision time
Number of independently observable decisions has not been established
